stories.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
stories.description: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.

stories.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
stories.description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

stories.title: Container ship hit by projectile sinks in Strait of Hormuz, Singapore says
stories.description: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.

stories.title: Houthi missile hits Aramco building after Saudi-led coalition strike on Yemen fuel depot
stories.description: The Saudi energy ministry says the Houthi attack caused a "limited fire" at Aramco's headquarters complex in Dhahran.

stories.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
stories.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

stories.title: Who are the Houthis and what do they want?
stories.description: Their fighting with pro-government forces over Yemen's Red Sea coast and attacks on Saudi Arabia has put the spotlight on the Iran-backed group.

stories.title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
stories.description: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.

stories.title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
stories.description: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.

stories.title: Watch: Why was the sign at the British consulate in East Jerusalem removed?
stories.description: The consulate, first established in 1838, was set to be closed by the Israeli government in retaliation for UK sanctions.

stories.title: Russia hails Trump waiving sanctions as 'historic'
stories.description: Russia on Saturday hailed US President Donald Trump's move to waive new sanctions on it as "historic", as Ukraine worries he is taking Moscow's side in Europe's worst conflict since World War II.

stories.title: Saudi-led forces try to break Houthi siege of Taiz with airstrikes
stories.description: Saudi-led forces say they’ve struck multiple positions around the Yemeni city of Taiz to break the Houthi siege.

stories.title: Iran war live: Israeli settlers attack EU diplomats; drones target Riyadh

stories.title: Iranian TV airs video said to show tanker explosion in Hormuz

stories.title: Albanian police fire rubber bullets as protests against Rama escalate

stories.title: Trump faces bipartisan backlash over Russia sanctions waiver
